title: Surreal clock scene
description: A large round clock with Roman numerals has its face replaced by a green hilly scene with a path, trees, a frog, and many butterflies and birds flying around it. In the center is a tall tower structure on a sphere with a smaller clock face whose hands point to ten minutes past ten.
prompt: A large round wall clock with black Roman numerals on a beige background has its center replaced by a surreal green hilly scene with a winding path, small trees, rocks, a blue frog at the bottom left, and many colorful butterflies and birds flying around the clock face. A tall gray tower stands on a sphere in the middle with a smaller clock face whose hands show ten past ten.
